The '''Master in Black''' was a small [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] who was one of the [[Five Masters]], the leaders of the [[Wookiee Liberation Front]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Masters established the [[Five Masters Academy]], a [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] [[school]] that was situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and the Master in Black became the Academy's instructor of the art of [[Stava (skill)|Stava]].
